scope: offline-only; no new Agent API calls, no contract replay, no Echidna fuzz

historical_agent_recovery.parser: json.loads only for ABI array arguments represented as strings; require decoded top-level list; then run original recursive ABI element/range, sender, transaction-count and schema validation
historical_agent_recovery.execution_claim: recovered sequences remain unexecuted; prior execution labels are read only from Phase43 ledger

paired_offline_selection.input_pool: all Phase44 development/evaluation candidate-ledger entries with existing replay feedback
paired_offline_selection.treatment: categorical direct-state progress only when an observed property operand moves from safe to a source-proven violation; unknown/neutral candidates retain control ranking and diversity
paired_offline_selection.retention_count_per_task: K=min(4, candidate pool size), fixed from the existing retain_diverse_prefixes default
paired_offline_selection.independent_diagnosis: after selection, verify direct target operand transitions from saved predicate getter rows and native Echidna corpus replay records; do not use official route/answer/reproducer inputs
paired_offline_selection.quick_validation_gate: only if historical data shows independently supported target progress selected better than control

metrics: excluded candidates with explicit prerequisite-state evidence
paired change under identical candidate pool and K
